issuer: the Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (Department of Public Safety and Corrections)
note: Louisiana Revised Statutes on legis.la.gov (read 2026-10-30): R.S. 32:408 names Class "E" the personal vehicle driver's licence; R.S. 32:412 charges $20.25 for a Class "E" licence outside New Orleans and has it expire on the birthday nearest six years after issue; R.S. 32:407 converts a learner's licence to an intermediate one from 16 and gives full Class "E" privileges after twelve months on it, so a full licence is kept from 17. R.S. 40:1321 charges $15 for a special identification card for anyone 16 or older, expiring every six years (under 16, $3 for two years or $7.50 for six; the $15 is the one held, and the card has no age). Not held: the Office of Motor Vehicles' handling fee on each transaction, New Orleans residents' fee. On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from R.S. 32:412(A)(7)(e)(i)(aa): 6 years at $20.25 under 70, and 6 years at $6.75 from 70 (the statute charges an applicant of seventy or older $6.75 and ends that licence too on the birthday nearest six years after issue); until then the file held the $20.25 licence for any age.

sources.title: R.S. 32:408, Examination of applicants required; classes of licenses
R.S. 32:412, Amount of fees; duration of license
sources.said: applicant for a Class "E" driver's license, or for a renewal of a Class "E" driver's license, except those bona fide residents of the city of New Orleans, shall pay for such basic license a fee of twenty dollars and twenty-five cents ... (7)(a) A Class "E" driver's license shall expire on the anniversary of the birthday of the applicant which is nearest to a period of six years subsequent to the issuing of the license ... (e)(i)(aa) Every applicant seventy years of age or older for a Class "E" driver's license, or for the renewal of a Class "E" driver's license, except those bona fide residents of the city of New Orleans, shall pay for such basic license a fee of six dollars and seventy-five cents, which shall be the cost of the license. ... The license shall expire on the anniversary of the birthday of the applicant which is nearest to a date of six years subsequent to the issuing of the license, unless revoked, canceled, or suspended.

sources.title: R.S. 32:407, Class "E" learner's and intermediate licenses
sources.said: The Class "E" learner's license may be converted to a Class "E" intermediate license upon the applicant being at least sixteen years of age ... for twelve consecutive months after being issued his intermediate license, an applicant may be issued full Class "E" driving privileges.

sources.title: R.S. 40:1321, Special identification cards
sources.said: The fee for the issuance or renewal of a special identification card for persons sixteen years of age or older shall be fifteen dollars. ... Each special identification card for a person sixteen years of age or older shall expire every six years but may be renewed.
